categories.name: Accommodation Management Rights
categories.description: A business operating accommodation management and associated letting or caretaking rights. Excludes general real estate agencies. The activity is the contracted accommodation-management, letting or caretaking operation. Ownership of an apartment or holiday unit alone is insufficient; general third-party real estate management has its own category.

categories.name: Caravan Park
categories.description: Operation of a caravan, camping or holiday park, including associated cabins and site services. Includes managed sites for touring caravans, campers and associated holiday cabins. A land holding without an operating park is different; permanent retirement accommodation belongs in the relevant living or care category.

categories.name: Guest Houses and Bed and Breakfast
categories.description: Visitor accommodation in a guest house or bed-and-breakfast establishment. Excludes permanent residential care. Includes small hosted guest accommodation and comparable owner-operated lodging establishments. Classification follows the accommodation operation, rather than ownership of a residential property or a property-management investment alone.

categories.name: Hostels and Backpacker Accommodation
categories.description: Budget visitor accommodation primarily in hostels or backpacker lodgings, commonly with shared facilities. Covers operating the accommodation business and its guest services, rather than selling the building alone. A separately operated cafe, tour service or other substantial activity may justify an additional category.

categories.name: Hotels
categories.description: Operation of a hotel primarily providing short-stay accommodation. A venue primarily operating as a pub or bar uses Pubs, Bars and Nightclubs. Includes accommodation-led hotels with associated guest facilities. Where the business is primarily a pub or nightlife venue, use that activity even if some rooms are available; a property-only sale is outside this scope.

categories.name: Motel
categories.description: Operation of a motel primarily providing short-stay accommodation for travellers. Includes traveller accommodation typically sold by room for short stays. Associated food services can be additional activities when substantial; an investment in the premises alone does not identify a motel operating business.

categories.name: Resort
categories.description: Operation of visitor accommodation with substantial integrated leisure or holiday facilities. Examples include holiday accommodation with integrated recreation, dining and guest amenities. The resort operation is primary; independent tour, retail or hospitality businesses should be classified by their own activities.

categories.name: Theme Park
categories.description: Operation of an admission-based theme or amusement park with permanent attractions. Includes operating a destination with permanent themed rides or attractions. Prefer the more specific children's play category for an indoor play centre; event performers and equipment hire are different operations.

categories.name: Tours and Experiences
categories.description: Operation of guided visitor tours, excursions or sightseeing experiences. Excludes an agency primarily reselling other operators' travel. Includes guided sightseeing and activity-based excursions sold as an organised visitor experience. Transport can be integral to the tour; add a transport category only for a separate passenger-carriage activity.

categories.name: Travel Agencies
categories.description: Travel agency, booking and travel arrangement services. Excludes operators primarily conducting their own tours or passenger transport. Includes businesses arranging bookings and travel products supplied by other operators. Conducting the operator's own tour or carrying passengers is a different activity, even when sold through the same booking channel.

categories.name: Aircraft Maintenance
categories.description: Aircraft maintenance, repair and associated technical support services. Excludes air transport, recreational flight experiences and aircraft dealers. Includes technical aircraft maintenance, repair and support businesses. Identify whether customers purchase equipment, maintenance or carriage; ownership of aircraft and an aviation customer base alone do not identify the operation.

categories.name: Aircraft Sales and Equipment
categories.description: Sale and supply of aircraft and aviation equipment. Excludes aircraft maintenance, passenger/freight carriage and recreational flight experiences. Includes aircraft dealerships, aviation equipment sales and related technical product supply. Determine whether the business sells equipment, maintains aircraft or carries passengers; the word aviation alone cannot distinguish these roles.

categories.name: Auto Electrical
categories.description: Installation, diagnosis and repair of electrical and electronic systems in motor vehicles. Excludes general building electrical work. Examples include vehicle wiring, starting/charging systems and electronic diagnostics. Repair of vehicle systems belongs here; manufacture of components, retail-only parts sales and building electrical contracting remain separate activities.

categories.name: Bicycle and Motorcycle Businesses
categories.description: Sale, servicing or repair of bicycles and motorcycles. Excludes a business primarily hiring recreational equipment. Includes specialist bicycle and motorcycle dealers and service workshops. Electric variants follow the same activity; vehicle technology alone does not create another category, and unrelated car dealerships or freight operators are excluded.

categories.name: Boat Sales and Equipment
categories.description: Sale and supply of boats, marine engines and related equipment. Prefer Marine Maintenance for maintenance and repair; excludes water transport and recreational marine experiences. Examples include boat dealerships and marine engine/accessory supply. A repair yard or boat maintenance contractor belongs under Marine Maintenance; charter experiences and passenger or freight carriage have separate scopes.

categories.name: Car Dealerships
categories.description: Sale of new or used passenger motor vehicles through a dealership. Excludes vehicle hire and truck-only dealers. Includes dealerships primarily earning from passenger-car sales. A substantial repair workshop or finance activity can be identified separately; selling business vehicles incidentally is insufficient to classify another business as a dealership.

categories.name: Car Rental
categories.description: Hire of passenger motor vehicles to customers. Excludes chauffeured transport and freight operations. Includes fleets hired to customers for self-drive use. A driver-supplied passenger service belongs under Taxi and Chauffeur Services; trading vehicles or renting accommodation is a different activity.

categories.name: Car Wash
categories.description: Operation of a vehicle washing business, including automated or self-service facilities. Prefer Detailing for specialist finishing and restoration. Includes staffed, automated and self-service vehicle wash operations. Specialist finishing and protection work can use Detailing; mobile delivery changes neither activity nor the distinction between washing and body repair.

categories.name: Detailing
categories.description: Specialist vehicle cleaning, polishing, surface protection and cosmetic detailing. Excludes panel repairs and routine mechanical repairs. Examples include intensive interior treatment, polishing and protective surface applications. Choose Vehicle Body Repairs for collision work; routine washing alone does not establish a specialist detailing business.

categories.name: Driving Schools
categories.description: Instruction in driving road vehicles, including learner and commercial driver training. Includes businesses selling road-driver instruction and associated practical lessons. General vocational training can be additional only when separately substantial; vehicle ownership or hire alone does not establish an instruction business.

categories.name: Marine Maintenance
categories.description: Boat and marine equipment maintenance, repair and technical services. Excludes boat dealers, sea transport and marine leisure experiences. Includes technical servicing, repair and maintenance of boats, engines and marine equipment. Sales, charters, leisure experiences and transport are different activities, even when the business owns vessels or waterfront premises.

categories.name: Service Station
categories.description: Retail sale of vehicle fuel through a service station, with or without an associated convenience shop. Includes operating a fuel-retail forecourt, with associated goods sales or amenities. A substantial convenience store may be another activity; wholesale fuel supply, extraction and electricity-generation businesses are different operations.

aliases.note: Vehicle fuel retail business.

categories.name: Truck Sales and Equipment
categories.description: Sale of commercial trucks and truck equipment. Excludes truck freight operators and general mechanical workshops. Includes dealers supplying commercial trucks and related equipment. Distinguish selling a truck from carrying a customer's freight or repairing a fleet; those businesses belong in transport or workshop categories.

categories.name: Vehicle Body Repairs
categories.description: Repair and refinishing of vehicle bodies after damage, including collision and panel work. Includes collision body repair, panel work and vehicle refinishing. Cosmetic detailing without repair uses Detailing; general mechanical servicing and selling replacement parts are different activities even when performed at the same premises.

aliases.note: Vehicle body repair and refinishing.
Vehicle collision body repair and refinishing.

categories.name: Vehicle Dismantling and Parts Recovery
categories.description: Dismantling vehicles and recovering used vehicle parts for resale or recycling. Includes recovering saleable vehicle components and materials from dismantled vehicles. General waste recovery is separate when broader materials processing is primary; an ordinary used-car dealership is not a dismantling operation.

aliases.note: Vehicle dismantling and used-parts recovery.

categories.name: Vehicle Mechanical Repairs
categories.description: Mechanical servicing and repair of road vehicles, including tyre fitting and wheel servicing. Excludes workshops primarily doing auto electrical or collision body repairs; a distinct parts sales activity can also use Vehicle Parts and Accessories. Includes servicing workshops, tyre fitting and wheel work where technical vehicle maintenance is primary. Vehicle sales, parts retail, auto electrical work and collision repairs can be separate categories when distinct operations genuinely exist.

aliases.note: Road-vehicle mechanical workshop.
Tyre fitting and wheel-service candidate.
Use for tyre fitting and wheel servicing; product sales are a separate activity.
Tyre fitting and wheel-service candidate.

categories.name: Vehicle Parts and Accessories
categories.description: Sale or distribution of motor vehicle parts and accessories, including tyres and wheels. Excludes vehicle manufacture and general repair workshops. A distinct fitting/servicing activity can also use Vehicle Mechanical Repairs. Includes specialist tyre, wheel, aftermarket and replacement-parts businesses. The product-sales role differs from fitting or mechanical servicing; selecting both requires actual sales and service activities, rather than incidental consumables used in repairs.

aliases.note: Motor vehicle parts and accessories.
Vehicle tyre/parts sales candidate.
Use for tyre/vehicle-parts sales; fitting is a separate service activity.
Vehicle tyre/parts sales candidate.

categories.name: Beauty Salon
categories.description: Provision of beauty treatments through a salon, excluding businesses primarily offering hair, nails, massage or spa services. Examples include facial, skin-care and general beauty-treatment businesses. A hair, nail, massage or spa operation should use its named category when primary; selling beauty products alone is retail or wholesale supply.

aliases.note: Beauty treatment services rather than product supply.

categories.name: Hair Salons and Barbers
categories.description: Hairdressing, barbering and associated hair salon services. Excludes businesses primarily selling hair products. Includes hairdressing salons and barber businesses, whether appointment-based or walk-in. A separate beauty-treatment or product-trading activity can justify another category; the sale of consumables incidental to a service is insufficient by itself.

aliases.note: Hair salon and barber services.
Hair salon services.

categories.name: Health Spa
categories.description: Operation of a health or beauty spa providing a combination of relaxation and personal treatments. Excludes hospital and medical care. Includes spas primarily selling a coordinated relaxation or personal-treatment experience. Accommodation-led resorts, medical clinics and standalone massage or beauty salons should use their more informative primary activity.

categories.name: Massage
categories.description: Provision of massage services. Excludes physiotherapy practices and businesses primarily operating a broader spa. Includes businesses primarily selling massage sessions and related non-equipment services. Physiotherapy remains a distinct clinical practice; an incidental massage offering within a broader spa does not require duplicate classification.

categories.name: Nail Salons
categories.description: Provision of manicure, pedicure and nail salon services. Includes businesses primarily providing nail-care appointments and related salon work. Other independently substantial beauty or retail activities can be combined; selling nail products to consumers or salons is a separate trading role.

categories.name: Natural Therapies
categories.description: Provision of complementary or natural therapy services. The category makes no claim about treatment efficacy or professional recognition. Includes practices primarily offering complementary or natural-therapy services, rather than selling products. Record the actual service being operated.

categories.name: Child Care
categories.description: Operation of childcare, early learning or out-of-school-hours care services. Excludes a business primarily selling children's products. Includes operating early-learning, childcare and out-of-school care businesses. Children's play venues, tuition, retail products and clinical support have their own scopes; serving children is not sufficient to select childcare.

categories.name: Education and Tutoring
categories.description: Provision of education, tutoring or learning services not better described by Child Care or vocational/professional Training. Delivery online does not create a separate industry. Examples include tutoring, subject tuition and general learning providers. Use Vocational and Professional Training for employment-related skills programmes; online delivery and the age of learners do not themselves establish another industry.

categories.name: Vocational and Professional Training
categories.description: Provision of vocational, professional or skills training. Excludes recruitment and general school-subject tutoring; online delivery does not change the activity. Examples include trade, workplace and professional-skills course providers. Delivery can be in person or online; course format does not establish accreditation, and staffing placement remains Recruitment and Staffing.

categories.name: Bakery
categories.description: Production and sale of bakery goods through a bakery business. Excludes general food factories not primarily operating as a bakery. Includes baking operations with their own bakery retail outlet. An independently substantial cafe can be combined; a general food factory or shop merely reselling packaged bakery products should use the appropriate production or retail activity.

categories.name: Butcher Shops
categories.description: Preparation and retail sale of meat through a butcher shop. Excludes livestock farming and broad food manufacturing. Includes meat preparation and retail through butcher shops. Livestock production, commercial food processing and trade wholesale remain separate; a deli offering alone does not require every food-retail category.

categories.name: Cafes and Coffee Shops
categories.description: Operation of a cafe or coffee shop primarily serving beverages and light meals. Excludes packaged coffee supply without a hospitality outlet. Examples include coffee shops and light-meal cafes. Combine with Bakery or a children's play operation when those are distinct businesses; coffee sold incidentally by an unrelated retailer does not establish a cafe.

aliases.note: Cafe or coffee shop operation.

categories.name: Catering
categories.description: Preparation and supply of food for events or customers away from a regular dine-in venue. Excludes venues primarily hired for functions. Includes preparing and supplying food for private, corporate and other events, often at customer or hired locations. Venue operation and event planning can be separate activities; carrying prepared food alone is transport rather than catering.

categories.name: Convenience Store
categories.description: Operation of a small general grocery and convenience shop. Prefer Service Station where vehicle fuel is the main activity. Includes neighbourhood convenience outlets with a mixed everyday grocery range. Choose Service Station where fuel retail is primary and Supermarket for a broad supermarket operation; opening hours alone do not determine classification.

categories.name: Delicatessens
categories.description: Retail sale of delicatessen foods, prepared meats, cheeses and related products, with or without food preparation. Includes deli shops primarily supplying specialist prepared foods, cured products and related items. Cafe service, meat butchery or wholesale should be additional categories only where each is a distinct substantial activity.

categories.name: Fruit and Vegetable Retail
categories.description: Retail sale of fresh fruit and vegetables. Excludes growing produce and general supermarkets. Includes greengrocers and similar outlets primarily selling fresh produce to consumers. Growing produce and supplying trade customers belong in farming or wholesale; general grocery stores are better described by their broader retail format.

categories.name: Juice Bar
categories.description: Operation of a juice or smoothie bar primarily preparing beverages for immediate consumption. Includes outlets primarily preparing juices, smoothies and comparable fresh drinks for immediate consumption. Bottled beverage manufacturing or distribution is different; a broader cafe should use the cafe category when that describes the main operation.

categories.name: Liquor Retail
categories.description: Retail sale of packaged alcoholic beverages through a liquor business. Excludes venues primarily serving drinks for consumption on site. Includes bottle shops and other outlets selling packaged alcoholic drinks to consumers. On-premises consumption-led venues use the pub/bar or restaurant category; wholesale distribution is a separate trading role.

aliases.note: Retail sale of packaged alcoholic beverages.
Retail sale of packaged alcoholic beverages.

categories.name: Restaurant
categories.description: Operation of a restaurant primarily preparing and serving meals for consumption on the premises. Includes dining establishments whose main operation is prepared meals served on site. A substantial takeaway operation may also be relevant; cuisine names and a delivery platform alone do not require separate categories.

aliases.note: Choose for a primarily dine-in pizza restaurant.
Choose for a primarily dine-in restaurant; takeaway-focused operations use Takeaway Food.

categories.name: Specialist Food Retail
categories.description: Specialist food or beverage retail not better described by a named shop category. Excludes hospitality and wholesale supply. Use for specialist consumer food shops not captured by the named bakery, butcher, deli, produce, liquor or grocery categories. Explain the main product range; a broad category should not replace a known more informative shop type.

categories.name: Supermarket
categories.description: Operation of a supermarket offering a broad range of groceries and household goods. Includes supermarkets supplying a broad grocery and household range. A small convenience outlet or specialist food shop has a different format; food manufacture and trade wholesale are separate business activities.

categories.name: Takeaway Food
categories.description: Preparation and sale of takeaway or quick-service food, including mobile food outlets. Excludes a business primarily providing event catering. Examples include primarily takeaway pizza, burger and fish-and-chip outlets, including food vans. Choose Restaurant where dine-in meal service is primary; mobility, cuisine and online ordering do not establish another industry by themselves.

aliases.note: Takeaway or quick-service food operation.
Takeaway fish-and-chip food preparation and sale.
Takeaway food operation.
Food preparation/sale from a mobile outlet.
Food preparation/sale from a mobile outlet; mobility alone is not an industry.
Choose for a primarily takeaway or quick-service pizza operation.
Choose for a primarily takeaway or quick-service operation.

categories.name: Beauty Product Wholesale
categories.description: Wholesale and trade supply of beauty, cosmetic and salon products. Consumer shops use Health and Beauty Retail; manufacturers use the relevant manufacturing category. Includes trade businesses buying and supplying beauty or salon products to business customers. Consumer shops, treatment providers and manufacturers have separate roles; identify the main customer and supply activity before classifying the operation.

aliases.note: Choose for wholesale/trade supply.
Previous draft label. Review the current scope; an alias is a search suggestion, not an automatic ID replacement.
Wholesale/trade supply rather than consumer retail.
Wholesale/trade supply to salons.

categories.name: Customs Brokerage
categories.description: Customs brokerage, clearance and related trade documentation services. Excludes businesses primarily carrying freight or trading goods. The core service is customs clearance, brokerage and trade documentation for clients. Freight forwarding or carriage can be additional activities when genuinely operated; importing the business's own stock alone does not make it a customs broker.

categories.name: Food and Beverage Wholesale
categories.description: Buying and reselling food or beverage stock to trade customers. Excludes freight-only delivery and general wholesale of non-food goods. Includes buying and reselling food or drink stock to business customers, often with associated distribution. Freight-only carriage, food manufacture and consumer retail are different roles; identify stock trading rather than simply the movement of goods.

categories.name: General Wholesale
categories.description: Buying and reselling goods to trade customers where a more specific product wholesale category does not apply. Excludes retail-only and freight-only businesses. Use for trade stock-reselling businesses without a more informative product wholesale category. Identify whether customers are businesses and whether the operator trades the goods; retail-only shops and carriage-only contractors are not wholesale activities.

categories.name: Import and Export Trading
categories.description: Trade businesses primarily sourcing or supplying goods across borders. Prefer a product wholesale category where more informative; excludes freight and customs services. Includes stock-trading businesses whose main role is import, export or both. Identify the direction of trade and product range; brokerage, carrying freight and selling the operator's own locally produced output are different roles.

categories.name: Electrical Equipment Manufacturing
categories.description: Manufacture of electrical equipment or components. Use Electrical in Construction and Trades for installation and maintenance contracting. Includes businesses making electrical equipment or components, rather than installing them at customer sites. A dealer, technical service contractor and manufacturer can serve the same industry while operating different business activities.

categories.name: Food and Beverage Manufacturing
categories.description: Manufacture or processing of food and beverages. Excludes hospitality outlets preparing meals primarily for their own customers. Includes commercial production and processing of food or drink for supply beyond the operator's own hospitality outlet. Trade wholesale, farming and consumer food retail are distinct stages and can be combined only for actual additional activities.

categories.name: Furniture and Timber Manufacturing
categories.description: Manufacture or processing of furniture, timber products and associated joinery. Excludes furniture-only retail. Includes production of furniture, timber goods and associated joinery. Furniture shops and building installation services remain separate; a combined maker/retailer can identify both actual activities without treating every supplier as a manufacturer.

categories.name: General Manufacturing and Production Engineering
categories.description: Manufacturing and production engineering businesses not better described by a specific product category. Excludes consultancy without production activity. Use for genuine manufacturing or production engineering without a suitable named product category. Identify the output being made; design-only consultancy, recovery of waste without production and ordinary repair work are different operations.

categories.name: Glass and Ceramic Manufacturing
categories.description: Manufacture or processing of glass and ceramic products. Excludes general retail of finished household goods. Examples include businesses producing or processing glassware, ceramic goods and relevant components. A shop selling finished household goods or a contractor installing glazing should be classified by the actual trading or service activity.

categories.name: Machinery and Metal Manufacturing
categories.description: Manufacture or fabrication of machinery and metal products. Excludes equipment dealers and machinery repair-only businesses. Includes machinery production and metal-product fabrication. Selling equipment, maintaining machines or supplying welding services alone are different activities; choose the more informative production category where the product is known.

categories.name: Mining and Earthmoving Services
categories.description: Mining services, extraction support and earthmoving operations. Use Civil for businesses primarily delivering civil infrastructure works. Includes specialist earthmoving, extraction-support and mining-contract operations. Prefer Civil for integrated civil infrastructure delivery; technical advice or sale of earthmoving equipment alone is not the same activity.

categories.name: Paper and Packaging Manufacturing
categories.description: Manufacture of paper, board, containers and packaging products. Excludes customer print/signage services and waste recovery as the main activity. Includes factories producing paper, board, packaging and containers for onward supply. A customer print shop or a waste-paper recovery business operates at another stage and should not be assigned this manufacturing category solely from its material.

categories.name: Plastics Manufacturing
categories.description: Manufacture or processing of plastic products and components. Excludes plastic waste recovery as the main activity. Includes production and processing of finished plastic goods or components. A distributor of finished products or a recycler recovering materials without manufacturing new goods should use its actual trading or recovery activity.

categories.name: Textile, Clothing and Footwear Manufacturing
categories.description: Manufacture of clothing, footwear or associated textile products. Excludes consumer fashion retail. Includes factories and production businesses making garments, footwear and textile products. Retail, trade wholesale and alteration or repair services are different roles; a fabric or fashion product label alone does not establish manufacturing.

categories.name: Adult Entertainment
categories.description: Adult entertainment venues or services. Excludes ordinary leisure venues and general retail. Includes businesses primarily providing adult entertainment services or operating associated venues. Ordinary nightlife, general entertainment and retail products have different scopes; classify the operated activity rather than a broad marketing description.

categories.name: Amusement and Arcade Businesses
categories.description: Operation of amusement, arcade or entertainment attractions. Prefer Children's Play and Activity Centres for a play-centre business and Theme Park for permanent themed attractions. Includes arcades and amusement attractions where another named leisure format is not more informative. Children's play centres and permanent theme parks have their own categories; general entertainment does not establish an attraction operator.

categories.name: Arts and Craft Experiences
categories.description: Provision of arts and craft experiences, workshops or leisure activities. Excludes a business primarily retailing finished goods or craft supplies. Includes participatory craft workshops, creative leisure sessions and similar customer experiences. Sales of art materials or hobby products use retail; production of content for customers or owned publications belongs in media activities.

categories.name: Children's Play and Activity Centres
categories.description: Operation of children's indoor play, activity and party centres. Excludes childcare, clinical care, tutoring and sports coaching as the main activity. Can combine with Cafes and Coffee Shops for a distinct cafe operation. Includes play-centre and children's activity-venue operators, often with party services. An independently substantial cafe can be combined; childcare, tutoring and clinical support are different activities despite sharing an audience.

aliases.note: Children's play/activity business rather than childcare.
Children's play/activity business rather than childcare.
Children's play/activity business rather than childcare.
Children's play/activity business rather than childcare.

categories.name: Function Centre
categories.description: Operation of a venue primarily hired for functions, weddings or events. Excludes event catering without a venue. Includes wedding, conference and private-function venues where hiring and operating the space is primary. Add Catering or Event Planning and Coordination only for a distinct service supplied by the business itself.

categories.name: Gambling Businesses
categories.description: Operation of gambling services or venues. Excludes newsagencies primarily retailing lottery products; the label does not imply a licence. Includes businesses operating gambling services or dedicated gambling venues. Lottery-product retail can instead be a newsagency/lottery outlet activity; category selection does not confirm permission to conduct a particular activity.

categories.name: Gyms and Sports Facilities
categories.description: Operation of a gym, fitness centre or sports facility. Excludes businesses primarily selling sporting products. Includes gym operators, fitness centres and businesses running sports facilities. Personal or sports services without a facility may fit Recreation and Sports Services; sale of exercise equipment alone belongs in retail.

categories.name: Live Entertainment Venues
categories.description: Operation of theatres, live music and performance venues. Excludes hospitality-led bars and businesses primarily supplying performers to other venues. Includes theatres, live-music spaces and other performance-venue operators. Supplying performers, running hospitality-led bars, selling recorded media and producing content for clients are different activities; a venue property alone is insufficient.

categories.name: Pubs, Bars and Nightclubs
categories.description: Operation of pubs, bars, nightclubs and similar venues primarily serving drinks or nightlife entertainment. Accommodation-led hotels use c0007. Includes pub, bar and nightclub operations primarily earning from on-site drinks and nightlife services. Accommodation-led hotels and packaged-liquor shops remain separate, even where the same business name includes the word hotel.

categories.name: Recreation and Sports Services
categories.description: Provision of recreation, sport or fitness activities not better described by a specific leisure category. Excludes clinical treatment and equipment-only retail. Use for recreation, coaching and sports services not captured by a named venue or activity category. Equipment shops, clinical practices and hire-only businesses have different scopes, even when their products or clients are sporting.

categories.name: Water Sports and Marine Experiences
categories.description: Provision of recreational water activities and marine leisure experiences. Excludes boat sales, technical marine services and sea transport. Examples include organised water-sport and marine recreation experiences. Boat dealers, technical marine contractors and passenger transport are different roles; equipment ownership or a waterfront location alone does not identify an experience business.

categories.name: Accounting Practices
categories.description: Provision of accounting, tax preparation and related accounting practice services. Prefer Bookkeeping where routine transaction records are the main service. Includes accounting practices whose core services extend beyond maintaining transaction records, including business accounts and related professional work. Bookkeeping-only operations, lending and investment businesses should use their actual service category.

categories.name: Bookkeeping and Payroll Services
categories.description: Provision of bookkeeping, payroll processing and routine financial recordkeeping services. Excludes broader accounting practices as the main activity. Includes outsourced bookkeeping, payroll administration and routine financial recordkeeping. Broader accounting practices and general back-office outsourcing are different scopes; software used to perform the work does not make it a software-product business.

categories.name: Business and Transaction Brokerage
categories.description: Intermediary services arranging transactions between buyers and sellers, such as business brokerage. Prefer Real Estate and Property Management for real estate agencies. Includes intermediaries primarily arranging business or other non-specialist transactions. Use Finance, Insurance or Real Estate for the named specialist activity; holding or selling the operator's own assets is not brokerage alone.

categories.name: Business Process Outsourcing
categories.description: Provision of outsourced administration, customer support and back-office operations. Prefer a named professional practice where that is the main service. Includes outsourced administrative processes, customer support and operational back-office services. Professional advice, recruitment and named accounting/bookkeeping services remain separate; a business client base alone does not establish professional advisory work.

categories.name: Civil Engineering Consultancy
categories.description: Civil engineering design, assessment and consultancy services. Excludes businesses primarily delivering construction works. Includes civil engineering advice, design and assessment supplied to clients. Delivering the resulting construction works is a different activity.

categories.name: Finance and Lending Services
categories.description: Provision or arrangement of finance and related financial services. Excludes accounting-only, insurance-only and general transaction brokerage businesses. Includes lending and finance-arrangement businesses and related specialist services. General bookkeeping, insurance, transaction brokerage and owned software tools have separate scopes; identify the financial service actually supplied to customers.

categories.name: General Professional and Advisory Services
categories.description: Professional or business advisory services not better described by a named profession. Excludes known specialist activities and general manual services. Use for professional or advisory services without a more informative named discipline. Routine outsourced operational work uses Business Process Outsourcing; a professional client base alone does not turn manual services into advisory work.

categories.name: Insurance Services
categories.description: Insurance brokerage, agency and related insurance service businesses. The category does not imply regulatory authorisation. Includes insurance agencies, brokers and related insurance-service operations. The classification concerns the business activity and does not imply an insurer relationship, authorisation or a particular distribution arrangement.

categories.name: Legal Practices
categories.description: Provision of legal practice and related legal advisory services. Excludes general business consultancy. Includes legal practice businesses and specialist legal advisory services for clients. General business consulting and document printing are different activities; ownership of a legal-sector technology product alone is not a legal practice.

categories.name: Marketing and Advertising Services
categories.description: Marketing, advertising, campaign and promotional services across digital and other channels. Excludes operating owned publications or supplying media production alone. Includes agencies providing marketing strategy, advertising, search, social and other campaign services. Channel terms remain aliases; operating owned content or supplying stand-alone media production is a separate activity rather than an automatic agency classification.

categories.name: Physical Security Services
categories.description: Physical security, guarding, monitoring and related security services. Excludes cybersecurity and businesses primarily installing alarm equipment. Includes guarding, monitoring and physical-security service operations. Installation of alarm equipment and cybersecurity have their own categories; selling a security product without providing the service is a separate role.

categories.name: Print and Signage Services
categories.description: Customer printing, copying, document finishing and signage production or installation. Excludes paper manufacture and photographic services as the main activity. Includes printing, copying, finishing and signage supplied to customers. Separate customer production from installation-only work and paper manufacture; product materials alone do not identify the commercial role.

categories.name: Publishing and Content Businesses
categories.description: Operation of owned publications, media channels, content libraries or audience businesses, including digital and subscription content. Customer media production uses Media Production Services; excludes software products and advertising agencies. Includes owned publications, channels, newsletters and content libraries monetised through audience, access or publication revenue. Production supplied to clients uses Media Production Services; retaining creative rights alone does not establish an owned publishing operation.

categories.description: Installation, inspection and maintenance of fire protection and safety systems. Excludes general guarding, medical care and emergency public services. Includes fire-system installation, inspection and maintenance businesses. Identify whether alarms, suppression systems or broader fire-safety servicing are primary; physical guarding and general security equipment installation are different activities.

categories.name: Gardening and Landscaping
categories.description: Provision of gardening, landscaping or grounds maintenance services. Excludes plant retail and agricultural crop services. Examples include lawn maintenance, gardening and landscaping contracts. Plant production, garden-product retail and irrigation-specialist work are separate scopes; an agricultural contracting business should use its rural activity instead.

aliases.note: Gardening/landscaping services.
Garden and grounds maintenance.

categories.name: Heating and Cooling Services
categories.description: Installation, maintenance and repair of heating, ventilation, air conditioning and refrigeration systems. Excludes equipment manufacture. Includes HVAC and refrigeration installation, maintenance and repair businesses. Distinguish the technical service from general electrical contracting, equipment retail and manufacture, even where the same products or customer sites are involved.

aliases.note: Heating, cooling and refrigeration services.
Heating, ventilation and air conditioning services.

categories.name: Irrigation Services
categories.description: Installation and maintenance of domestic, landscape or agricultural irrigation systems. Excludes industrial water treatment. Additional categories can identify a distinct agricultural or landscaping activity. Includes irrigation contractors serving gardens, landscapes, farms or several customer sectors. Selling equipment alone, operating a water utility and supplying unrelated landscaping or farm services are different activities.

categories.name: Painting and Decorating
categories.description: Painting, decorating and associated surface-finishing services for buildings. Excludes vehicle refinishing. Includes building painting, decorating and related surface-finishing contractors. Product retail, industrial manufacture and vehicle refinishing have different scopes; choose the actual service rather than the paint or coating material alone.

categories.name: Plumbing and Drainage
categories.description: Plumbing, drainage and related installation or maintenance services. Excludes industrial water treatment and irrigation as the main activity. Includes plumbing and drainage contractors supplying installations, repairs and maintenance. Identify the actual trade service; customer-site work does not make the operator a general builder, water utility or irrigation specialist.

categories.name: Roofing and Exterior Services
categories.description: Installation, repair and maintenance of roofing, gutters, cladding and associated building exteriors. Excludes general construction as the main activity. Includes contractors specialising in roofs, gutters, cladding and related exterior work. Separate contracting from selling materials or manufacturing components; a generic construction category does not automatically cover every repair-only service.

categories.name: Welding and Fabrication Services
categories.description: Provision of welding and related metal joining or fabrication services. Prefer a named manufacturing category where complete product manufacture is the main activity. Includes welding contractors and fabrication-service workshops primarily supplying skilled joining or metalwork services. Manufacture of complete machinery or metal products can be a separate activity; identify what is delivered rather than the material alone.

categories.name: Battery and Energy Storage Services
categories.description: Supply, installation, operation or maintenance of energy storage systems. Excludes general battery retail without an energy-storage service focus. Includes businesses supplying, installing, operating or maintaining battery energy-storage systems. Establish the commercial role and system focus; ordinary battery-product retail, general electrical contracting and generation-only operations are different activities.

categories.name: Electric Vehicle Charging Services
categories.description: Operation, installation or maintenance of EV charging infrastructure as the main business. Excludes general vehicle sales and electrical contractors without a charging focus. Includes businesses operating charging networks or primarily installing and maintaining charging infrastructure. Distinguish operating a charging network from installation and maintenance; supplying equipment alone does not establish this service activity.

aliases.note: Charging infrastructure operation, installation or maintenance.

categories.name: Energy Generation and Supply
categories.description: Operation of energy generation or supply businesses. Excludes primarily installing customer energy systems and upstream oil/gas extraction. Includes operating energy-generation or energy-supply businesses. Establish whether the operator generates, supplies, installs or maintains systems; fuel extraction and customer installation contracting are separate stages.

categories.name: Environmental Consulting
categories.description: Environmental assessment, monitoring and advisory services. Excludes waste collection and materials recovery operations. Includes specialist environmental assessments, monitoring and advisory services supplied to clients. Physical waste collection, remediation operations and resource recovery are different activities.

categories.name: Oil and Gas Businesses
categories.description: Oil and gas extraction, processing or specialist support operations. Excludes retail vehicle fuel stations. Includes upstream oil/gas operations and specialist processing or support businesses. Fuel retail and general electricity supply have separate scopes; renewable generation cannot be assigned here simply because both activities concern energy.

categories.name: Recycling and Resource Recovery
categories.description: Recovery of reusable materials from waste or end-of-use products. Excludes ordinary waste collection without recovery and businesses primarily manufacturing new goods. Includes businesses recovering reusable materials and preparing resources for further use. Producing new finished goods and collecting waste without recovery are different activities; a generic manufacturing or freight category is not an automatic substitute.

categories.name: Renewable Energy Services
categories.description: Installation, maintenance and support of renewable energy systems, including solar and wind. Excludes electricity generation/supply and businesses primarily providing EV charging or battery storage services. Includes specialist solar, wind and comparable renewable-system service businesses. Distinguish installation/maintenance from generating or selling energy, and identify any separate charging or storage operation rather than assuming every energy business is electrical contracting.

aliases.note: Renewable energy installation/service rather than electricity generation.

categories.name: Waste Collection and Management
categories.description: Collection, handling and management of waste. Prefer Recycling and Resource Recovery where materials recovery is the main activity. Includes businesses whose main role is waste collection, handling or management. Recovery of reusable material is separate when primary; operating collection vehicles does not automatically make the business a general freight carrier.

categories.name: Water Supply and Treatment
categories.description: Industrial water supply, treatment or processing operations. Excludes domestic pool maintenance and garden irrigation. Includes operating industrial water-supply, treatment and related processing services. Selling water-treatment equipment alone, maintaining pools and installing farm or garden irrigation systems are different commercial roles.

categories.name: Animal Care and Grooming
categories.description: Animal care, grooming and related services. Prefer Pet Boarding for overnight pet boarding; excludes animal retail and veterinary clinical services. Includes non-clinical pet-care services such as grooming, washing, day care and training. Overnight boarding and veterinary clinical work have named categories.

aliases.note: Non-clinical animal care/grooming.
Non-clinical animal care/grooming.

categories.name: Pet Boarding
categories.description: Temporary boarding and overnight care of pets. Excludes breeding, animal retail and veterinary practices. Includes boarding kennels and catteries whose main service is temporary overnight accommodation. Day grooming and clinical veterinary care remain separate; a combined operator can identify those activities independently.

aliases.note: Overnight pet boarding.

categories.name: Veterinary Services
categories.description: Provision of veterinary clinical services for animals. Excludes pet retail, boarding and non-clinical grooming or care. Includes clinical animal-health practice businesses. Non-clinical grooming, boarding and product retail remain separate; a substantial independently operated retail or boarding service can be an additional activity when justified.

aliases.note: Veterinary clinical services.

categories.name: Cleaning Services
categories.description: Commercial, domestic and specialist cleaning of buildings and facilities. Excludes laundry/dry cleaning, vehicle washing and specialist pest control. Includes businesses mainly cleaning buildings, premises and facilities for clients. Garment care, vehicle washing and specialist pest management have named scopes; equipment sales alone does not establish a cleaning-service business.

categories.name: Facilities Management
categories.description: Coordinated management of building operations and contracted maintenance services. Excludes a single specialist trade and real estate sales agencies. Includes businesses coordinating building operations and several maintenance/service contracts. Pure real estate agency, strata administration and a single trade have separate scopes; a management activity is not established by property ownership alone.

categories.name: Pest Management
categories.description: Pest management, inspection and treatment services. Excludes agricultural hunting/trapping and general cleaning as the main activity. Includes pest inspection, prevention and treatment businesses for buildings and other customer sites. General cleaning, garden maintenance and agricultural wildlife contracting have different scopes; the relevant service must be identified.

categories.name: Pool and Spa Maintenance
categories.description: Pool, spa and associated domestic water-system cleaning and maintenance services. Excludes industrial water treatment and irrigation contracting. Includes pool and spa cleaning, routine maintenance and associated domestic system services. Construction of a pool, industrial water treatment and irrigation contracting are different activities rather than automatic extensions of maintenance.

categories.name: Real Estate and Property Management
categories.description: Real estate agency, property management and related property service businesses. Excludes a property asset sale without an operating service business. Includes real estate agencies and third-party property management services. Facilities coordination, strata administration and accommodation management rights have separate scopes; a sale of property without an operating service business is not enough.

categories.name: Self Storage
categories.description: Operation of customer-controlled storage units and associated storage services. Excludes trade warehousing and vehicle parking as the main activity. Includes operating customer-accessed storage units and associated self-storage services. This differs from hiring equipment, managing property for others and handling trade inventory; the operated storage service matters rather than property ownership alone.

categories.name: Strata and Body Corporate Management
categories.description: Administration and management services for strata or community-title schemes. Excludes accommodation management rights and property asset sales. Includes administrative and management services for strata and community-title schemes. Accommodation letting, general tenancy management, coordinated maintenance and property investment are different roles, even when conducted for the same building.

aliases.note: Strata/body-corporate management.

categories.name: Franchise
categories.description: Operates under a franchise agreement using an established brand and business system. Combine with the activity actually carried out, such as food service, retail or cleaning. This characteristic does not identify the industry, distinguish a new franchise opportunity from an existing business, or establish the terms or transferability of the agreement.

aliases.note: Business characteristic only; select at least one activity and confirm the definition against the actual operation.
Business characteristic only; select at least one activity and confirm the definition against the actual operation.

categories.name: Home Based
categories.description: Operates principally from a residential home rather than dedicated commercial premises. Combine with the goods or services the business provides. Home administration alone does not establish that an otherwise premises-based operation is home based. This characteristic does not imply that the home is included in the sale or that the business is relocatable.

aliases.note: Business characteristic only; select at least one activity and confirm the definition against the actual operation.
Business characteristic only; select at least one activity and confirm the definition against the actual operation.
Business characteristic only; select at least one activity and confirm the definition against the actual operation.

categories.name: Online Operation
categories.description: Conducts a substantial part of its core business through websites, apps or other online channels. It can apply to retail, software, content or services when online delivery or transactions are central to the operation. A marketing website alone is insufficient. Dedicated premises can also apply; this characteristic does not identify an activity or imply an online-only business.

aliases.note: Business characteristic only; select at least one activity and confirm the definition against the actual operation.
Business characteristic only; select at least one activity and confirm the definition against the actual operation.
Business characteristic only; select at least one activity and confirm the definition against the actual operation.
Suggests both Online Operation and Premises Based; neither establishes the business activity.

categories.name: Mobile Operation
categories.description: Delivers its core goods or services by travelling to customers or operating from a vehicle or movable unit. Combine with the actual activity, such as repairs, food service or cleaning. Routine delivery by a premises-based business does not by itself establish a mobile operation. Mobility does not imply that the business can transfer to another service territory.

aliases.note: Business characteristic only; select at least one activity and confirm the definition against the actual operation.
Business characteristic only; select at least one activity and confirm the definition against the actual operation.

categories.name: Relocatable
categories.description: Can transfer its operating base to another location while retaining the core business being offered. Use where the seller has established that the relevant customer relationships, assets and operating arrangements can support a move. Home-based, online or mobile operation alone is insufficient. This characteristic does not promise that a transfer is unrestricted or cost free.

aliases.note: Business characteristic only; select at least one activity and confirm the definition against the actual operation.
Discovery term only; confirm the operating base can actually move before selecting Relocatable.

categories.name: Business with Property
categories.description: Offers the operating business together with ownership of the property used by that business as part of the sale. Combine with the operating activity. Leasing or occupying premises alone does not qualify, and a separate optional property opportunity should be described according to the actual sale arrangement. This characteristic does not cover a property-only sale.

aliases.note: Business characteristic only; select at least one activity and confirm the definition against the actual operation.
Business characteristic only; select at least one activity and confirm the definition against the actual operation.
Business characteristic only; select at least one activity and confirm the definition against the actual operation.

categories.name: Owner Operated
categories.description: Has an owner actively involved in day-to-day operation or delivery of its core goods or services. Combine with the business activity. This characteristic describes the current operating arrangement, rather than a promise about a buyer's future workload. An owner can work alongside a manager; owner involvement and under-management arrangements are not automatically mutually exclusive.

aliases.note: Business characteristic only; select at least one activity and confirm the definition against the actual operation.
Business characteristic only; select at least one activity and confirm the definition against the actual operation.

categories.name: Under Management
categories.description: Has a manager responsible for day-to-day operations while the owner primarily provides oversight. Combine with the business activity and verify the actual division of responsibilities. An owner may still work in the business. This characteristic does not promise passive income, an absent owner, guaranteed staffing continuity or a particular future workload for the buyer.

aliases.note: Business characteristic only; select at least one activity and confirm the definition against the actual operation.
Business characteristic only; select at least one activity and confirm the definition against the actual operation.

categories.name: Premises Based
categories.description: Uses dedicated operating premises, whether leased or owned, for a substantial part of its core activity. Combine with the goods or services provided. A business may also operate online or deliver mobile services. Occupying premises does not mean ownership of the property is included in the sale; use Business with Property only for that separate fact.
